markets.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays per reception by Courtland Sutton in the Seattle vs Denver Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 15, 2026. The Yes contracts pay based on this schedule: 0 receptions, $0.0000; 1, $0.0003; 2, $0.0029; 3, $0.0098; 4, $0.0233; 5, $0.0455; 6, $0.0787; 7, $0.1250; 8, $0.1865; 9, $0.2656; 10, $0.3644; 11, $0.4850; 12, $0.6297; 13, $0.8006; 14 or more, $1.0000. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract shown above follows this calculation:
Payout Formula = floor(10000 x (min(s, 14) / 14)^3) / 10000
s = official receptions

The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout.
